description: List ad groups (ad sets) for a paid ads provider, optionally filtered by campaign. Use after nevent_list_paid_campaigns to drill down into a campaign's ad sets. Returns ad group IDs, names, statuses, and lastSyncedAt. Use the returned adGroupId values with the ad group insights, targeting, and comparative stats tools.

campaignId.description: Optional: filter ad groups by parent campaign ID. Use nevent_list_paid_campaigns to get valid campaignId values.

name: nevent_list_paid_ad_groups
